A '''B1 battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Ambush" />

==History==
During the [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|space ambush]] over [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] was ordered by an [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] to shoot down [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] and, later, the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] released from it. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] made an effort to shoot Yoda's pod down, but was unable to do so and was scolded by the command droid.<ref name="Ambush" />
